name: asset-create
description: Creates Unity object assets under Assets/: prefab, or a ScriptableObject asset from a non-abstract ScriptableObject inheritor type name. Scripts, shaders, uxml, uss, json, and other text files can be created by the agent directly without using this tool.

path.description: Project-relative asset path starting with Assets/, e.g. Assets/MyFolder/MyAsset.asset or Assets/MyFolder/MyPrefab.prefab.

type.description: prefab, or a non-abstract ScriptableObject inheritor type name such as MySettings or My.Namespace.MySettings.
